tools.name: find_smart_glasses
tools.description: Find source-checked smart glasses by country, use case and required features. Returns a bounded shortlist in catalog order, not a best-product ranking. Unknown regional software support does not satisfy required software features. No live inventory or checkout.

tools.name: compare_smart_glasses
tools.description: Compare two or three product IDs using source-linked specifications, indicative prices, strengths, caveats and country-specific feature status. Missing facts remain unknown; prices are not live quotes.

tools.name: get_buying_links
tools.description: Get the published retailer links for one product and an explicit country. Preserve affiliate URLs exactly, disclose commissions, and confirm variant, shipping, taxes and stock at the retailer. Does not place orders.
